profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Delivering over a decade of experience in software engineering, specializing in frontend and backend development, system integration, and deployment for defense, intelligence, and satellite communication industries. Demonstrates a proven ability to design, develop, and optimize robust software solutions that drive system performance, reliability, and security. Adept at implementing software systems for mission-critical applications and ensuring seamless integration with hardware and cloud-based infrastructures. Skilled in automation, scripting, code reviews, and debugging to enhance software quality and functionality while consistently meeting project and customer requirements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
*Worked as a Software Engineer from May 2010 - Feb 2022 and again but as Senior Software Engineer from March 2025 - Present*

Developed and implemented software systems for defense and intelligence applications, ensuring high performance, reliability, and adherence to mission-critical requirements.

  
Architected software interfaces to integrate mission-critical military communications hard improving system reliability across defense applications.
  
Conducted rigorous end-to-end testing and authored technical documentation for new software features to accelerate deployment cycles.

Partnered with domain subject matter experts to diagnose field-reported hardware/software defects, deploying rapid workaround and patch fixes.
positions.insights: Bash, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and +10 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: North Charleston, South Carolina, United States
positions.description:
Designed and developed software solutions to support defense and intelligence systems, focusing on enhancing system performance, security, and operational efficiency.

Managed AWS cloud infrastructure, optimizing deployment schemas to maintain high availability and security compliance for defense systems.
  
Configured and integrated cloud services with a focus on robust testing and security protocols, enhancing system resilience.

Analyzed existing software architecture and pitched feature enhancements that expanded system capabilities and operational efficiency

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and implemented software solutions for complex electromagnetic measurement systems, ensuring the accuracy and performance of data acquisition.

Engineered robust software solutions to control laboratory test instruments and industrial equipment optimizing performance and functionality.
  
Collaborated with cross-functional engineering teams to integrate hardware-software modules and maintain on-time project milestones.

Performed code review processes to enforce clean code standards and elevate overall system stability.
positions.insights: Git BASH, Problem Solving and +7 skills

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and optimized software solutions for satellite communication systems, enhancing network performance and ensuring reliable connectivity for global customers.

Managed AWS cloud infrastructure, optimizing deployment schemas to maintain high availability and security compliance for defense systems.
  
Configured and integrated cloud services with a focus on robust testing and security protocols, enhancing system resilience.
  
Analyzed existing software architecture and pitched feature enhancements that expanded system capabilities and operational efficiency.
